summary: Workspace / multi-user feature fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (1 skipped — no separate cross-workspace super-admin available to assert the 404-outsider case; mitigated because .env ADMIN_EMAIL likely coincides with demo). Frontend: nav-gating, direct-route redirect, create-user flow, delete-user flow all verified against the preview URL for both budi (regular) and demo (admin).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: admin.insert_one in /api/admin/users does not grant any welcome credits (STARTING_CREDITS skipped) which is correct because the regular user uses the admin's shared wallet. Good.
chat.py add_participants currently 403s for non-owner non-admin participants but 400s on private — verified.
WebSocket at /api/ws/{cid} correctly closes with 4401 for invalid token and 4403 for forbidden conversation — verified via two separate rejection tests.

Shared wallet contract verified: regular user's SSE /send on a shared persona increments the admin workspace's wallet.consumed (admin had 0 available at test time, so decrement was observed via consumed delta instead of available delta). Suggest also exposing a 'balance_after_last_usage' for easier assertions.
Minor: admin.create_workspace_user ignores admin's 'theme' setting ('light' hardcoded) while all other settings inherit — intentional but worth noting.
test_credentials: Admin demo@aivora.ai / demo123456; Regular budi@aivora.ai / budi123456; QA users created via POST /api/admin/users at runtime and cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Fresh TEST_meeting_ws meeting created per test module with 2 shared personas + budi as participant; fresh qa_user_<uuid8>@aivora.ai created and deleted per module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workspace feature complete. test_workspace_feature.py is sync (uses asyncio.run inside sync tests for WS to avoid needing pytest-asyncio). WS rejection assertion treats either exception OR immediate close as 'rejected'. For the outsider-404 test, pass a credential whose user owns a different workspace via env ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD (currently it maps to demo so the test is skipped). The regular-user wallet decrement test checks either delta_available>0 or delta_consumed>0 against the admin's /api/wallet because admin may already be at 0 available.
